Camille & Mitch 


I was in awe of Camille and Mitch’s wedding celebration. It’s not every day that I get to feel like that about a wedding; but this wedding floored me. 

I was captivated by the unbelievable styling of this wedding, the florals were second to none, thanks to Hollingsworth Studio. It was so very chic and luxurious. The colours, designs, flowers and Camille’s Alin Le Kal wedding dress was a show stopper. Everything came together to create a stunning wedding that I was excited to be at and document.

Rupert on Rupert is one of my favourite Melbourne Wedding venues. It is an exotic, natural and beautiful industrial event space. The abundance of indoor plants makes you feel like you are getting married outside in the tropics. From the ceremony to the reception, one thing was sure; this wedding was set to be memorable. Thanks for letting me be a part of your day Camille and Mitch.
